title: Oct bank reconciliation – split payment second installment missing from ledger

documents.text:
Wira Stationery Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-B101
Oct 2026 office supplies
Total: RM1,500.00

Meja Prints Sdn Bhd
Invoice INV-B102
Oct 2026 commercial printing
Total: RM6,000.00
Payment plan: two equal instalments of RM3,000 each
1st instalment due: 10 Oct 2026
2nd instalment due: 24 Oct 2026

Payment Receipt REC-B01
From: BrightMart Sdn Bhd
Date: 20 Oct 2026
Amount: RM8,000.00

ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. Difference RM0.00 after adjustment ADJ-B1.

ground_truth.explanation: Bank shows two payments of RM3,000 each to Meja Prints (B3 + B4) matching the split-payment terms on INV-B102 (RM6,000 in two instalments). The ledger only records the first instalment (L3). The second instalment (B4 = RM3,000, 24 Oct) is missing from the ledger. ADJ-B1 incorrectly labels it a timing item. Add the missing ledger entry for the second instalment.
